title: Node's CPS Counter
description: This mod add CPS Counter in the game
body:
Node's CPS Counter (Fabric 1.21.11)
A simple, lightweight, and customizable CPS Counter mod I made for Fabric 1.21.11. It displays your clicks-per-second directly on your screen with zero performance impact. I designed it to be completely minimalist to ensure it won't distract you during intense PvP fights or survival gameplay, keeping your FPS perfectly stable. It features a built-in Chroma (RGB rainbow) color mode and custom positioning, allowing you to move the counter anywhere on your screen and adjust its appearance precisely to your liking right inside the game!

🎗️ Important Note: This mod is completely free to use. If you want to support my work, please consider donating to LÖSEV (Foundation for Children with Leukemia) to help children in need instead of supporting me. Every donation counts!
